body.message:
Hi! I am looking for a Master Bedroom (with attached bathroom), a studio, or a room in a shared apartment for myself. I work in Dubai and I have a valid Emirates ID. I am looking for a long-term stay (minimum 6 months) with monthly payments. 

Budget: Max 3,500 - 4,000 AED/month (All bills included: DEWA, Wi-Fi, AC). 
Occupancy: 1 person (just me).
Status: Employed in Dubai with Emirates ID.
Move-in date: As soon as possible (18th August)

Please send me available options with photos and locations. Thanks!
